description: This file defines an internal singleton object 'DeviceAuthPayload' with functions to build an authentication payload string and normalize metadata fields for devices.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs a version 3 device authentication payload string from provided device and metadata information.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes a metadata string by trimming, converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase, and handling empty or null values.
